limitations: Complete Swiss fossil steam-methane-reforming hydrogen is a screening proxy for the inspected global refinery-hydrogen market, factor+1kg per signed source kg. The source contains seven positive refinery-hydrogen suppliers summing to one kg and no freight/loss extras; do not replace it with electrolysis or infer a future IAM hydrogen mix.

Refinery integration, crude/natural-gas feedstock, coproduct allocation, purification, utilities, infrastructure, emissions and regional supply shares differ from dedicated native SMR. Retain the complete native inventory once; source refinery burdens are not reconstructed. Score effects are unquantified and no production/LCIA equivalence is claimed.

Native hydrogen leaves production at25bar; the source gaseous market has no verified matching delivery pressure. Preserve mass without a pressure/density/yield factor, invented compressor, delivery leg or expansion credit. Geography and vintage remain explicit proxies.

Approval is restricted to the inspected ecoinvent3.9cutoff source through the UVEK2025native bridge to UVEK2026/biosphere3.10. Uninspected releases, inverse and cross-system-model routes remain unsupported.
alternatives_rejected: Electrolysis changes the fossil refinery-hydrogen supply to an electricity-intensive pathway.
A700bar fuelling-station SMR inventory adds high-pressure compression and delivery that the source does not specify.
Reconstructing all crude-refinery inventories is not supported by a native refinery-hydrogen counterpart; no fictitious yield or allocation factor is introduced.
